UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set data-testid on all interactive buttons, links, cards, inputs, tabs, and form submissions.
Preserve the metallic silver logo and electric-blue brand guidelines strictly. Do not use blue as background colors; keep it strictly for accent glows, active highlights, and primary CTA touches.
Use smooth Lenis scroll and Framer Motion staggered entry animations across all sections.
Avoid generic card grids. Use asymmetrical editorial spacing, 1px subtle dark graphite borders, and dark glassmorphic overlays.
Ensure custom cursor on desktop handles normal hover, link expansion, and project card 'VIEW' text mode gracefully, while staying completely hidden on touch/mobile devices.
Form inputs must validate inputs properly and submit to the backend FastAPI endpoint (/api/contact) or react form state with instant feedback toasted via Sonner.
